title: 第一卷 第69章 跪着，没死就滚出村！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

迎上闫老革失望的目光，闫建钢咬着牙，低下头。

“带去祠堂！”闫老革一挥手，转身走在前边。

众人浩浩荡荡的跟着闫老革，向着祠堂方向走去。

闫老革拿出钥匙，

上闫村的祠堂不是很大，正前方是三尊木像，名曰，何姚三位。

按照族谱上记载，何姚三位乃是亲兄弟，只不过，二爷跟三爷，分别过继给其他亲戚家，改了姓。

后来，二爷、三爷认祖归宗，虽改回闫姓，却也没有忘记何姚二姓。

三尊祖宗雕像，之所以叫何姚三位，而不是闫何姚三位，是因为闫，无需多言，是个人都知道，三位祖宗是闫姓。

众人跟着闫老革，走进祠堂。

闫老革走到放置何姚三位神像的架子前，拿起放在上边的三根香，用火柴将其点燃。

随着闫老革持香礼拜，其他人也纷纷弯腰拜祭。

将三根清香插进香鼎。

闫老革转身看向瘫坐在地的闫建钢，冷声道，“闫建钢，你知道错了没？”

闫建钢梗着脖子，那张脸扭曲着，迎上闫老革森森然的目光，道：“村长，我哪里错了？”

“你还不认错！？”闫老革冷哼一声，叱喝道，“你偷政府给的赈灾粮，这便是不可饶恕的大罪。事情败漏，你不想着改过自新，逃出村，这是第二错。你偷偷回村，爬进村委会，想要干什么？你不知道村委会只有憨妞跟楚欣芸嘛？”

“村长，你都说了，那是政府给的赈灾粮，我闫建钢也是上闫村的村民，给我一些怎么了？”

“好好好！”闫老革见闫建钢还在胡搅蛮缠，不由得怒极而笑，道：“我不跟你废话，从现在开始，你给我跪在这里。你要是敢逃，老子要了你的命。”

闫建钢咬着牙，怒视着闫老革，吼道：“凭什么？凭什么让我跪在这里？大不了，我不在上闫村待了，你有什么资格让我跪在这里？闫老革，你这是在犯法！”

“犯法？”闫老革深吸一口气，大步走向瘫坐在地的闫建钢，居高临下的盯着他，“你现在跟老子说犯法？老子告诉你，在上闫村，法救不了你。老子就把话搁在这里，你给老子老老实实跪在这里忏悔。三天后，你要是不死，就滚出上闫村！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Facing Yan Laoge's disappointed gaze, Yan Jiangang gritted his teeth and lowered his head.

"Take it to the ancestral hall!" Yan Laoge waved his hand, turned around and walked ahead.

Everyone followed Yan Laoge in a mighty manner and walked towards the ancestral hall.

Yan Laoge took out the key.

The ancestral hall in Shangyan Village is not very big. Right in front are three wooden statues named He and Yao.

According to the records in the genealogy, the three He and Yao are brothers. However, the second master and the third master were adopted by other relatives and changed their surnames.

Later, the second and third masters recognized their ancestors and returned to the clan. Although they changed their surname back to Yan, they did not forget the second surname He Yao.

The reason why the three ancestor statues are called He and Yao San, not Yan, He and Yao San, is because Yan, needless to say, everyone knows that the three ancestors have the surname Yan.

Everyone followed Yan Laoge into the ancestral hall.

Yan Laoge walked to the shelf where the three statues of He and Yao were placed, picked up the three incense sticks placed on it, and lit them with matches.

As Yan Laoge held incense and worshiped, others also bent down to worship.

Insert three sticks of fragrance into the incense cauldron.

Yan Laoge turned around and looked at Yan Jiangang, who was slumped on the ground, and said coldly, "Yan Jiangang, do you know you are wrong?"

Yan Jiangang frowned, his face twisted, and he met Yan Laoge's solemn gaze and said, "Village Chief, where did I go wrong?"

"You still haven't admitted your mistake!?" Yan Laoge snorted coldly and shouted, "You stole the disaster relief food provided by the government. This is an unforgivable crime. When things were revealed, you didn't want to change your past and escape from the village. This is your second mistake. You secretly returned to the village and climbed into the village committee. What do you want to do? Don't you know that there are only Han Niu and Chu Xinyun in the village committee?"

"Village Chief, you already said that it was disaster relief food given by the government. I, Yan Jiangang, am also a villager in Shangyan Village. What's wrong with giving me some?"

"Okay, okay!" Yan Laoge couldn't help laughing angrily when he saw that Yan Jiangang was still messing around, and said: "I won't talk nonsense to you. From now on, you kneel here for me. If you dare to run away, I will kill you."

Yan Jiangang gritted his teeth, glared at Yan Laoge, and shouted: "Why? Why do you let me kneel here? No matter what, I won't stay in Shangyan Village anymore. What qualifications do you have to let me kneel here? Yan Laoge, you are breaking the law!"

"Breaking the law?" Yan Laoge took a deep breath, strode towards Yan Jiangang who was slumped on the ground, and stared at him condescendingly, "Are you telling me that you broke the law now? I'm telling you that in Shangyan Village, the law can't save you. I'll leave it here, and you can honestly kneel here and repent to me. After three days, if you don't die, get out of Shangyan Village!"

title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 69 Kneel down and get out of the village before you die!
